metadata.source: International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) & Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)

boundary_join.note: Unmatched districts are newer districts created after the Census boundary file (e.g. Telangana, Chhattisgarh). They retain full data and profile access without spatial polygons.

stunting.label: Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)
stunting.description: Height-for-age < -2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

wasting.label: Children under 5 years who are wasted (%)
wasting.description: Weight-for-height < -2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

underweight.label: Children under 5 years who are underweight (%)
underweight.description: Weight-for-age < -2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

anaemia_children.pattern: Children age 6-59 months who are anaemic
anaemia_children.label: Children age 6-59 months who are anaemic (%)
anaemia_children.description: Haemoglobin concentration < 11.0 g/dl among children age 6-59 months.

anaemia_women.pattern: All women age 15-49 years who are anaemic
anaemia_women.label: All women age 15-49 years who are anaemic (%)
anaemia_women.description: Haemoglobin concentration < 12.0 g/dl for non-pregnant and < 11.0 g/dl for pregnant women.

low_bmi_women.pattern: Body Mass Index \(BMI\) is below normal
low_bmi_women.label: Women age 15-49 years with BMI below normal (%)
low_bmi_women.description: Body Mass Index (BMI) < 18.5 kg/m² indicating chronic adult energy deficiency.

overweight_women.label: Women age 15-49 years who are overweight or obese (%)
overweight_women.description: Body Mass Index (BMI) >= 25.0 kg/m² indicating adult adiposity.

improved_drinking_water.label: Population with improved drinking-water source (%)
improved_drinking_water.description: Population living in households with an improved drinking-water source.

improved_sanitation.label: Population with improved sanitation facility (%)
improved_sanitation.description: Population living in households that use an improved sanitation facility.

clean_cooking_fuel.label: Households using clean fuel for cooking (%)
clean_cooking_fuel.description: Households using electricity, LPG/natural gas, or biogas for cooking.

women_literacy.label: Women age 15-49 who are literate (%)
women_literacy.description: Women age 15-49 who completed standard 9 or higher or can read a whole sentence.

institutional_births.label: Institutional births (%)
institutional_births.description: Percentage of births delivered in a health facility.

immunization.pattern: fully vaccinated based on information from either vaccination card or mother
immunization.label: Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)
immunization.description: Received BCG, measles, and 3 doses each of polio and DPT/penta.

exclusive_breastfeeding.pattern: Children under age 6 months exclusively breastfed
exclusive_breastfeeding.label: Children under 6 months exclusively breastfed (%)
exclusive_breastfeeding.description: Infants 0-5 months receiving only breast milk (no water or other liquids/foods).

pregnant_women_anaemia.pattern: Pregnant women age 15-49 years who are anaemic
pregnant_women_anaemia.label: Pregnant women age 15-49 who are anaemic (%)
pregnant_women_anaemia.description: Haemoglobin concentration < 11.0 g/dl in pregnant women.

selection.rationale: Selected K=3 (K-Means, Euclidean): achieved highest silhouette score (0.265) among K in [3..6] with Davies-Bouldin index 1.3855, satisfying bootstrap stability constraint with mean ARI 0.8138 >= 0.60.

limitations: NFHS-5 survey estimates reflect sample survey data (2019-21) and carry sampling errors and standard confidence intervals.

District boundaries in Districts.geojson (2011 Census base) contain 641 shapes, leaving approximately 88 newer districts created post-2014 (such as in Telangana and Chhattisgarh) without visual map polygons.
Exclusive breastfeeding (262 missing) and anaemia in pregnant women (134 missing) exhibit high missingness and are excluded from clustering to preserve data completeness.
District groups represent exploratory similarity profiles across the 7 nutritional dimensions and should not be used as clinical rankings or performance scores.
